Manchester, England-based  Dj/producer Andy Stott is a purveyor of smudged and introspective dub techno with an approach that favours leaden tempos and unsettling, sample-based textures. 
in 2011, Stott released two full-length albums, Passed Me By and We Stay Together, both of which received attention from Pitchfork.com and other noteworthy music blogs.

title: American Drift
desc_lfm_album: American Drift is the first studio album by American electronic musician and composer Elysia Crampton, after her previous work under the name E+E. It was released on August 7, 2015, on Blueberry Records and was released to high critical acclaim from various critics. .
desc_lfm_artist:
Elysia Paula Crampton Chuquimia is an American Aymara electronic musician. Their work touches upon themes of Aymara survival and Latin culture, queerness and its historic roots in aforementioned Aymara history, naturalist themes, and frequent utilization of samples and arrangements from varying sources.
Past and present aliases include E+E, Elysia Crampton Chuquimia, Chuquimamani-Condori

title: Mutant
desc_lfm_album: Mutant is the second studio album by Arca, released on November 20, 2015, via Mute Records. According to Arca, the album chronicles, "sensuality and impulsiveness as escape routes out of rigidity". It has been labeled as a noise, trap, industrial and experimental album. To promote Mutant, four singles were released: "Vanity", "Soichiro", "En" and "Front Load" – the later being released as a promotional single. Upon release, the album was critically acclaimed and was ranked as Tiny Mix Tapes' favorite album of 2015. .

desc_lfm_artist: Slikback (real name: Freddy M Njau) is an electronic producer from Nairobi, Kenya. His 2018 debut EP Lasakaneku launched Nyege Nyege Tapes' offshoot label Hakuna Kulala, and he is one of Nyege Nyege’s greatest success stories so far. He only began making music a couple of years ago, and he quickly amassed a catalog several hundred tracks deep. Lasakaneku was followed in 2019 by Tomo, a six-track EP capturing an even darker, more agitated snapshot of his global club sound.

title: Source of Denial
desc_lfm_artist:
Nihiloxica is a project that harnesses the full force of the ancient Bugandan drumming tradition of Uganda and focuses it on the contemporary dance floor through a dark lens of techno sensibility. 

Formed by UK musicians Spooky-J & pq and members of the Nilotika Cultural Ensemble, incubated in Kampala by acclaimed label Nyege Nyege Tapes, the cross-continental band explore the common ground between techno and tradition, a conversation between two cultures with a common aim: to make people dance.

title: Classical Curves
desc_lfm_artist: Jack Latham is a UK electronic music producer and DJ who performs under the alias Jam City. He has been active since 2010 and records on the label Night Slugs. He has released two full-length albums: 2012's Classical Curves and 2015's Dream a Garden. He has also produced for artists such as Kelela, Troye Sivan, and Gaika.

title: Beside Myself
desc_lfm_artist:
DJ Haram is the alias of Zubeyda Muzeyyen, a producer and DJ based in Philadelphia. DJ Haram is a producer and DJ who distinctively ties her New Jersey musical history with more recent involvement in the Philadelphia DIY noise scene, whilst paying homage to her Middle Eastern roots. A close affiliate of New York's Discwoman collective, she is also one half of 700 Bliss, alongside rapper and poet Moor Mother, who feature on this EP. 
She has released the EP Handplay (2023) and the full album Beside Myself (2025) on Hyperdub.
